address: 3799 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109

zones.label: Category A
zones.description: Category A is the closest ticket tier across the room’s angled seating banks. It keeps you near the dancers and the front edge of the choreography.

zones.label: Category B
zones.description: Category B is part of our Sweet Spot / Our Pick. You stay close enough for detail while gaining a cleaner view of the full formations.

zones.label: Category C
zones.description: Category C is also part of our Sweet Spot. It gives the choreography more breathing room while still feeling connected to the stage.

zones.label: Categories D–F
zones.description: Categories D–F sit progressively farther back in the angled banks. They are useful when a wider view and lower price matter more than proximity.
